ideas.children_he: פַּרְעֹה חָלַם חֲלוֹם מוּזָר עַל פָּרוֹת, וְהִתְעוֹרֵר מְבֹהָל.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh dreamed of seven healthy cows and seven thin cows fighting. He woke up shocked by the dream.

ideas.children_he: גַּם הַחֲלוֹם הַשֵּׁנִי הִדְאִיג אֶת פַּרְעֹה כִּי לֹא הֵבִין אוֹתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh dreamed of seven good wheat stalks and seven thin dry stalks that ate the good. The dream was strange and surprising.

ideas.children_he: גַּם אֲנָשִׁים חֲכָמִים לֹא תָּמִיד יוֹדְעִים אֶת כָּל הַתְּשׁוּבוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh woke up upset and called wise men and priests to solve the dreams, but no one could.

ideas.children_he: שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים נִזְכַּר בְּיוֹסֵף שֶׁעָזַר לוֹ בֶּעָבָר.
ideas.children_en: The cupbearer met Joseph in prison and Joseph successfully solved the dreams of the cupbearer and baker.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הִסְבִּיר שֶׁהַחָכְמָה לֹא בָּאָה רַק מִמֶּנּוּ.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh sends for Joseph, who says God solves dreams, and he will help Pharaoh understand.

ideas.children_he: פַּרְעֹה סִפֵּר לְיוֹסֵף אֶת חֲלוֹמוֹ וְחִכָּה לְהֶסְבֵּר.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh tells Joseph the dream of seven good cows and stalks and seven bad ones that ate the good. He did not understand.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הִסְבִּיר שֶׁהַחֲלוֹמוֹת מְבַשְּׂרִים עַל שָׁנִים טוֹבוֹת וְשָׁנִים קָשׁוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Joseph explains the dreams are prophecy: seven years of plenty, then seven years of famine; God tells Pharaoh the future.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים יֵשׁ שֶׁפַע, אֲבָל צָרִיךְ לְהִתְכּוֹנֵן גַּם לִזְמַנִּים קָשִׁים.
ideas.children_en: The first seven years will be a time of plenty in Egypt, then seven years of hard famine will consume the land.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הִסְבִּיר שֶׁהַחֲלוֹם חָזַר כְּדֵי לְהַדְגִּישׁ אֶת חֲשִׁיבוּתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: The plenty will end with famine; the dream repeated twice to show God's word will surely come true.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף לֹא רַק פָּתַר אֶת הַחֲלוֹם, אֶלָּא גַּם הִצִּיעַ תָּכְנִית מַעֲשִׂית.
ideas.children_en: Joseph suggests appointing a smart man to manage Egypt, save food in good years, and prepare for bad years.

ideas.children_he: פַּרְעֹה הִבְחִין בְּחָכְמָתוֹ שֶׁל יוֹסֵף וְהֶאֱמִין בּוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Joseph's solution pleased Pharaoh and his servants, who saw him as a wise advisor with God's spirit.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף עָבַר מִבֵּית הַסֹּהַר לְתַפְקִיד חָשׁוּב בְּמִצְרַיִם.
ideas.children_en: Pharaoh made Joseph his deputy with great power, gave him a signet ring and honor, and ruled all Egypt.

ideas.children_he: בַּשָּׁנִים הַטּוֹבוֹת יוֹסֵף אָסַף מָזוֹן כְּדֵי שֶׁיִּסְפִּיק לֶעָתִיד.
ideas.children_en: Joseph, age thirty, started collecting grain during seven good years, organizing and storing it across Egypt cities.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף הֵקִים מִשְׁפָּחָה וְנָתַן לְבָנָיו שֵׁמוֹת בַּעֲלֵי מַשְׁמָעוּת.
ideas.children_en: During the good years, Joseph had two sons, Manasseh and Ephraim, names meaning forgetting and gaining.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁהִגִּיעַ הָרָעָב, הַמָּזוֹן שֶׁנֶּאֱסַף עָזַר לָאֲנָשִׁים.
ideas.children_en: The seven good years ended, seven famine years began, and all Egypt was hungry; Pharaoh sent them to Joseph.

ideas.children_he: תִּכְנוּן נָכוֹן בִּזְמַן שֶׁפַע יָכוֹל לַעֲזֹר גַּם לַאֲנָשִׁים מֵאֲרָצוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת.
ideas.children_en: Famine was everywhere, including neighbors, who came to buy grain from Joseph, fulfilling his dream fully.
